title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a variety of focused environments across the Dickinson campus, from high-tech science lounges to quiet historic reading rooms.

cards.title: Waidner-Spahr Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Private Group Spaces
cards.notes: Reserve one of 13 enclosed rooms across three levels. Upper and main level rooms feature flat panel monitors and USB-C connectivity for collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed private rooms in the main campus library equipped with collaborative technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has 13 study rooms located on the upper level, main level and lower level. Study rooms on the upper and main level are equipped with a flat panel television monitor and USB-C.
cards.source_title: Study Room Use & Reservation Guidelines - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Reservations must be made 8 hours in advance; sessions are limited to three hours per day.

cards.title: Tome Science Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Historic Tome Hall
cards.notes: Located on the second floor of Tome Hall, this quiet space is ideal for consulting print journals in physics, astronomy, and math.
cards.short_summary: A specialized reading room on the second floor of Tome Hall focused on scientific disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: This reading room, located on the second floor of Tome, is a beautiful space for consulting books and recent print journals in Astronomy, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science and Mathematics.
cards.source_title: Tome Science Reading Room | Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Open to students, staff, and faculty at all times.

cards.title: Rector Science Complex Interaction Spaces
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Science Lounges
cards.notes: Find comfortable collaborative work areas and study nooks tucked between laboratories and faculty offices in this modern facility.
cards.short_summary: Modern, collaborative study nooks and interaction spaces within the Rector Science Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The complex includes comfortable collaborative work and study spaces... additional study nooks were included in the expansion.
cards.source_title: A Look Inside Dickinson College's Rector Science Complex
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; designed for interdisciplinary student-faculty interaction.

cards.title: Bosler Hall Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Traditional Library Vibe
cards.notes: A spacious area with soft lighting and a balcony lined with bookshelves, offering a traditional library atmosphere without the main library's stress.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, traditional-style study area located on the mezzanine level of Bosler Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The mezzanine area in Bosler is this beautiful, spacious area with soft lighting... a beautiful balcony lined with bookshelves.
cards.source_title: Three Totally Underrated Places to Study Around Campus - The Dickinsonian
cards.access_notes: Open during Bosler Hall building hours.

cards.title: Althouse Hall Basement Lounge
cards.subtitle: Casual Sofa Study
cards.notes: Features comfortable sofas and a common-room atmosphere, perfect for casual review or a quick rest between classes.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed basement lounge in Althouse Hall with sofas for casual studying.
cards.evidence_claim: There is an area in the Althouse's basement where you definitely can study there... those sofas are there for you to lie down and take some rest.
cards.source_title: Places to Study on Dickinson's Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Althouse Hall; accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: HUB Micro Room
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Computing
cards.notes: A dedicated computing facility located in the Holland Union Building (HUB) that remains accessible 24 hours a day for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour computer lab and study space located within the Holland Union Building.
cards.evidence_claim: HUB Micro Room, 24 hours a day. The Underground (HUB), 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Available 24 hours a day for students.

cards.title: Stern Center Front Patio
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Garden Study
cards.notes: Equipped with tables and chairs near a pretty garden, this patio offers a quiet outdoor alternative to the more social Britton Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor study area with tables and chairs in front of the Stern Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The front patio of Stern Hall: This is a beautiful place to get work done when the sun is out... there are really cute tables and chairs outside.
cards.source_title: Three Totally Underrated Places to Study Around Campus - The Dickinsonian
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; best for fair weather.

cards.title: Denny Hall First Floor Corners
cards.subtitle: Quiet Introvert Nooks
cards.notes: Find a pillowy sofa in a cozy corner on the first floor of Denny Hall for a quiet, focused environment away from campus rush.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, comfortable seating areas on the first floor of the historic Denny Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny Hall's First Floor... take a seat on a pillowy sofa in a cozy corner on the first floor of Denny Hall.
cards.source_title: Places to Study on Dickinson's Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Denny Hall building hours.

cards.title: Weiss Center Art Study Hallway
cards.subtitle: Creative Corridor
cards.notes: A dedicated study hallway within the Weiss Center for the Arts, providing a quiet space surrounded by the college's art and music departments.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study hallway located within the Weiss Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art and Art History Department's facilities... consist of numerous buildings and spaces: Weiss Center for the Arts... Art & Art History Study Hallway.
cards.access_notes: Open during Weiss Center building hours.

cards.title: Stuart Hall Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Group Discussion Hub
cards.notes: Ideal for group work, this space features blackboards and chalk to help students visualize and present ideas during study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A group-friendly study area on the second floor of Stuart Hall featuring blackboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Stuart Building's Second Floor. This is the best place for group study or discussion. You can see that black board and chalk are provided.
cards.source_title: Places to Study on Dickinson's Campus
cards.access_notes: Seats fill quickly after school; morning or afternoon visits are recommended for availability.
